meta.name: historical-interview-scripts
meta.description: 自媒体创作者在策划历史名人访谈短视频时，当需要融合古今反差与网络热梗打造爆款，使用本技能可自动生成包含吸睛标题、主持人串词与爆笑问答的完整结构化脚本，轻松产出高传播力的趣味短视频文案。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把历史名人访谈变成自带热梗的爆笑短视频脚本
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是做历史类短视频的创作者,想快速产出有梗的访谈脚本
copy.tagline_en: Turn historical figure interviews into viral short-video scripts with internet memes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're a short-video creator making history content and need quick meme-driven interview scripts

howto.what: 收到历史名人访谈短视频需求时，Claude 会产出一份结构化脚本：带话题标签的标题、本期嘉宾与梗概、开场主持人串词、主持人提问接名人爆笑回答的访谈正文，以及收尾的互动引导。
howto.when: 当你要求创作历史人物访谈、趣味历史内容或短视频文案时触发；也可指定人物、要求脑洞联动或系列创作。

say.text: 写一期李白和李清照的访谈短视频文案，主题是古代文人的现代职业选择
say.note: 输出标题、串词、问答与互动引导的完整文案

say.text: 帮我创作秦始皇、武则天、朱元璋的访谈，主题是古代 CEO 的管理哲学
say.note: 按人物分段，每人配提问和爆笑回答

say.text: 设计一个系列：李清照吐槽苏轼，走互怼风格
say.note: 走脑洞联动分支，可规划多期

howto.what_en: Claude turns a request for a historical-celebrity interview short video into a structured script: headline with hashtags, guest and premise list, host opening, Q&A with meme answers, and a closing call to action.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a historical figure interview script, playful history content, or short-video copy.

say_en.text: Write an interview script with Li Bai and Li Qingzhao on their modern careers.
say_en.note: Gives headline, host lines, Q&A, and closing prompt.

say_en.text: Script an interview with Qin Shi Huang and Wu Zetian on ancient CEO management.
say_en.note: Each guest gets a question and a meme answer.

say_en.text: Plan a series where Li Qingzhao roasts Su Shi in a back-and-forth style.
say_en.note: Uses the brainstorm branch; can plan several episodes.
